rationale: The agent performed order-changing actions without explicit customer confirmation and did not adhere to the user’s conditions. Specifically: (1) They appear to have canceled order #W2702727 outright without first confirming with the user or verifying whether it could be processed within 5 days, which the user required. (2) They modified the shipping address on #W8268610, whereas the user explicitly requested the address change for #W2702727—this suggests acting on the wrong order. (3) There’s no evidence the agent confirmed either change before executing them, violating the policy to confirm all order-changing writes. (4) The agent did not provide the requested totals: the refund total for the canceled order and the total price after the address change. While the agent did look up the user and both orders, these critical errors mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
